# Cognition Today

> A cognitive science resource exploring how the brain works, AI's impact on human cognition, and practical strategies for mental performance and well-being.

Cognition Today publishes evidence-based articles on neuroscience, psychology, and cognitive science, bridging academic research with practical applications for readers interested in brain health, AI literacy, and cognitive optimization. The site covers foundational cognitive theory, the neurobiology of everyday behaviors, and critical perspectives on emerging technologies like large language models.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Science
- Neuroplasticity
- AI & LLMs
- Cognitive Biases
- Brain Health
- BDNF & Neurogenesis
- Emotional Intelligence
- Creativity
- Stress Management
- Exercise & Brain
- Mental Health
- Misinformation
- Enclothed Cognition
- 4E Theory of Cognition

## Cognitive Science Foundations

- [How does Cognition happen?](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/how-does-cognition-happen): The 4E theory of cognition: embodied, extended, enactive, and embedded cognition.
- [9 Cognitive biases affecting most of our decisions](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/9-cognitive-biases-affecting-most-of-our-decisions): Nine thinking errors including choice overload, confirmation bias, and survivorship bias.
- [Why we Fall for Misinformation so Easily](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/why-we-fall-for-misinformation-so-easily): Cognitive biases explaining misinformation: illusory truth effect and confirmation bias.

## AI, Technology & Human Cognition

- [6 Skills AI cannot replace (yet)](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/6-skills-ai-cannot-replace-yet): Human skills superior to ChatGPT and LLMs: creativity and emotional intelligence.
- [7 Negative Effects of ChatGPT on your Mind](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/7-negative-effects-of-chatgpt-on-your-mind): Cognitive decline and mental health risks from ChatGPT and LLM dependency.
- [6 Skills You are better at than AI](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/6-skills-you-are-better-at-than-ai): Human advantages over AI in creativity, emotional intelligence, and interpersonal skills.
- [Speed changed our Attention span](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/speed-changed-our-attention-span): How digital speed affects attention spans, multitasking, and modern media consumption.

## Brain Health & Performance Optimization

- [Exercise is STILL the best NYE resolution](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/exercise-is-still-the-best-nye-resolution): Exercise's cognitive benefits via hippocampus, amygdala, and BDNF mechanisms.
- [How to Biohack your Energy Level (7 steps)](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/how-to-biohack-your-energy-level-7-steps): Seven biohacking steps using adenosine, caffeine, glucose, and the 20-20-20 rule.
- [Mental Effects of 7 mundane Daily Habits](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/mental-effects-of-7-mundane-daily-habits): Psychological impact of clothes, exercise, gum, coffee, music via enclothed cognition.
- [7 Test-Anxiety Solutions, very easy](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/7-test-anxiety-solutions-very-easy): Seven stress-management techniques for exam anxiety and cognitive performance.

## Mind-Body Connection & Lifestyle

- [Mind-Body Connection: 8 hobby ideas for 2026](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/mind-body-connection-8-hobby-ideas-for-2026): Eight hobbies building mind-body connection through neuroplasticity and skill development.
- [6 Hobbies that teach Psychology](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/6-hobbies-that-teach-psychology): Social hobbies teaching psychology through personality and emotional expression.
- [6 Forms of Beauty: Which do you admire?](https://cognitiontoday.com/web-stories/6-forms-of-beauty-which-do-you-admire): Beauty psychology and aesthetic philosophy including Wabi-Sabi and ethical beauty.
